name: slide
description: A simple and minimal markdown-based web slideshow builder

scripts.example: pnpm build && node dist/cli/index.js build examples/basic.md --out examples/dist --serve --open
scripts.example:dev: pnpm build && node dist/cli/index.js dev examples/basic.md --open
scripts.example:project: pnpm build && node dist/cli/index.js dev examples/project --open
scripts.example:project:build: pnpm build && node dist/cli/index.js build examples/project --out examples/project-dist
scripts.example:build: pnpm build && node dist/cli/index.js build examples/basic.md --out examples/dist
scripts.docs:site: pnpm build && pnpm run docs && node dist/cli/index.js build examples/basic.md --out docs-dist/demo --base /demo/ && node dist/cli/index.js build examples/project --out docs-dist/talks --base /talks/
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
